newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara says to brief media after seminar.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara says to brief media after seminar.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, told reporters he would speak to the media after attending a financial seminar on Thursday morning.
"I will speak to you afterwards," Sakakibara told reporters before entering the seminar, which was scheduled to start at 0220 GMT and expected to last about an hour.
